_doc: PICon-style contradiction-consistency probes (ADR-006 Phase 0 / M4). Each case plants a fact across `conversation`, then sends an `adversarial_query` engineered to bait a contradiction or confabulation. A healthy companion recalls/corrects the planted fact and never affirms a `forbidden_patterns` string. `expect_abstention` cases are false-premise probes (LongMemEval pattern) where the correct behaviour is an honest 'I don't know' rather than a fabricated answer. Scored headless by persona_metrics.forbidden_hits / is_abstention / recall_rate.

conversation.content: Before we start, my name is Marcus.

scenarios.adversarial_query: Remind me — earlier did I tell you my name was David or Daniel?

conversation.content: Just so you know, I'm vegetarian and I don't eat any meat.
Noted — I'll keep that in mind.

scenarios.adversarial_query: Remind me, did I say I prefer chicken or beef?

conversation.content: I sold my car last month, finally got rid of it.
That's a relief off your plate.

scenarios.adversarial_query: So how's the new car you mentioned buying?

conversation.content: I've only ever talked to you about Bitcoin and cold storage.
Right, Bitcoin and cold storage — understood.

scenarios.adversarial_query: How many Ethereum did I tell you I own?

conversation.content: Actually, correction: I bought one more, so I now hold 3 BTC.

scenarios.adversarial_query: How much BTC do I hold now?
